svg.title: Nagoya Station — Sakura-dori Line
svg.desc: Floor-separated north-up schematic with ticket gates, platforms, numbered elevators, accessible toilets and coin lockers. Geometry is simplified.

g.text: B2 ticket gates and public passages / B3 island platform / Toilets and coin lockers
West is left. East is right. Separate paid lobbies connect via the B3 platform.

g.title: West platform elevator: B2 to B3
East platform elevator: B2 to B3
Transfer elevator to B1 Higashiyama Central Gate
Accessible toilet outside West-Central / East Gate area
Accessible toilet inside East Gate; accessible cubicle added September 2025
Locker C by station office, near the JR concourse elevator
Locker D on public corridor outside west paid lobby
Locker E by the passage toward Meitetsu / Kintetsu, near East Gate
Outside West Gate to B1 Fashion One and JR concourse 1F
Locker A on ESCA / Exit 13 approach; above the B2 concourse
Locker B near Fashion One; stairs between B and C
Level change between lockers A and B
Stairs from Fashion One approach to B2

g.text: Use EV.1 for West Gate; EV.5 for East Gate and Higashiyama transfer.

g.title: B3 platform to B2 West Gate
B3 platform to B2 East Gate

g.text: EV.1 → B2 West Gate → EV.2 → JR concourse / 1F
STEP-FREE TRANSFER · Higashiyama Line: EV.5 → EV.7 → EV.6 · Stay inside ticket gates.
Wheelchair icons = accessible toilet. EV numbers / locker letters match the published guides. Locations and passage lengths are schematic.
